small_guidance: The GEMM kernel looks correct in isolation; the correctness failure (avg diff ~0.08) likely comes from replacing the lm_head nn.Linear, which in GPT-2 shares weights with wte (transposed). TritonLinear clones+transposes weight at init, so subsequent weight-tying breaks, but more importantly verify dtype: GPT-2 weights are fp32 and inputs are long; ensure x2d.contiguous() and that bias dtype matches. Also restrict replace_linears to skip the lm_head or handle tied weights by referencing the original parameter (no clone).
large_guidance: Redesign replacement to (a) only replace Conv1D inside transformer blocks (attn c_attn/c_proj, mlp c_fc/c_proj) and leave lm_head as the original nn.Linear so weight-tying with wte is preserved, or (b) keep a live view of the tied weight (store reference, transpose on the fly or use non-transposed B with a kernel variant) so updates/tying remain consistent. Additionally, fuse the bias-add and (for mlp.c_fc) GELU into the GEMM epilogue to cut memory traffic.
